stories.title: Drug test on Daniel Maldini after Milan car crash was negative

en.title: Drug test on Daniel Maldini after Milan car crash was negative
en.summary: Daniel Maldini tested negative for drugs following a Milan car crash, though he remains under investigation for drink driving. The Cagliari forward was called up to the Italy squad despite having his driving licence suspended.

stories.title: Daniel Maldini, test sulle droghe negativo dopo l’incidente di Milano

en.title: Daniel Maldini, drug test negative after Milan crash
en.summary: Drug testing after a Milan car crash showed negative results with no substance impairment detected, though an alcohol test remained positive. The player faces a drink-driving charge.

stories.title: Daniel Maldini negativo alle sostanze stupefacenti

en.title: Daniel Maldini negative for narcotics
en.summary: Following a Milan crash, Daniel Maldini tested below the threshold for narcotics. He remains under investigation for drink-driving offences.

stories.title: Daniel Maldini, negativo test tossicologico del Niguarda: livelli di stupefacenti sotto la soglia

en.title: Daniel Maldini, Niguarda toxicology test negative: drug levels below threshold
en.summary: A toxicology test revealed drug levels below the legal threshold following a Milan car crash, though a drink-driving charge and licence suspension remain in effect.

stories.title: Daniel Maldini negativo agli esami sugli stupefacenti in ospedale, valori sotto la soglia

en.title: Daniel Maldini tests negative for drugs in hospital, values below threshold
en.summary: Daniel Maldini tested positive in preliminary drug screening following a car accident in Milan on September 13, but hospital examination results came back negative with values below the legal limit.

stories.title: Presidi: il tetto nelle classi agli stranieri è condivisibile, ma difficile da applicare

en.title: School principals: cap on foreign students in classes is understandable but difficult to implement
en.summary: The head of Italy's national principals association responded to Premier Giorgia Meloni's announcement of a rule limiting the maximum number of foreign students per classroom, acknowledging the policy's rationale while expressing implementation challenges.

stories.title: Usava i social dai domiciliari, Mario Adinolfi va in carcere

en.title: Mario Adinolfi returns to prison for using social media while under house arrest
en.summary: Mario Adinolfi was sent to prison after violating house arrest conditions by posting on social media, facing accusations including fraud and tax violations.

stories.title: Mario Adinolfi torna in carcere, usava i social dai domiciliari: aggravamento della misura

en.title: Mario Adinolfi returns to prison for using social media while under house arrest
en.summary: Mario Adinolfi's house arrest was escalated to prison after he posted 49 articles and 23 social media posts while supposed to be under home detention.

stories.title: Mario Adinolfi portato in carcere, su Fb posta: “Mi stanno arrestando perché scrivo sui social”

en.title: Mario Adinolfi taken to prison, posts on Facebook: "They are arresting me because I write on social media"
en.summary: Journalist and former parliamentarian Mario Adinolfi was transferred to prison after authorities served him an order. He had been under house arrest since July 8 on suspicion of involvement in a large-scale fraud scheme.

stories.title: Adinolfi torna in carcere: usava i social ai domiciliari

en.title: Adinolfi returns to prison: he used social media while under house arrest
en.summary: Authorities determined that Adinolfi violated house arrest conditions by publishing online content, including numerous articles and social posts. He is accused of collecting money from investors for an illegal betting system with promised guaranteed returns.

stories.title: Morto a 27 anni il figlio di Cindy Crawford. Presley Gerber, modello, era in un centro riabilitativo

en.title: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford and model, dies at 27. He was in a rehabilitation center
en.summary: Presley Gerber, a model and son of Cindy Crawford, has died at age 27. The family's spokesperson requested privacy during this difficult time, and the cause of death has not been disclosed.

stories.title: Berlino alla sinistra e Pomerania all'estrema destra, Merz: "Un disastro"

en.title: Berlin to the left and Pomerania to the far right, Merz: "A disaster"
en.summary: The Socialist Left party wins in Berlin's capital while the AfD prevails in the northeast, representing further electoral losses for the German chancellor's coalition.

stories.title: Nexture si rafforza in Medio Oriente con l’acquisizione di La Crema

en.title: Nexture strengthens in Middle East with acquisition of La Crema
en.summary: Nexture, a food ingredients and added-value solutions company controlled by Investindustrial, has agreed to acquire La Crema in a move to expand its presence in the Middle Eastern market.

stories.title: Mutui, l’impatto dei tassi: rincaro medio fino a 540 euro all’anno sui nuovi contratti

en.title: Mortgages, the impact of rates: average increase up to 540 euros per year on new contracts
en.summary: New mortgage contracts in October for 130,000 euros face estimated additional costs of approximately 540 euros annually, totaling around 13,500 euros over 25 years due to current interest rate levels.

stories.title: Dal coworking alle case: Wao scommette sugli affitti flessibili

en.title: From coworking to homes: Wao bets on flexible rentals
en.summary: Wao, a company offering flexible rental options ranging from one night to one year for apartments, is expanding its business model beyond coworking spaces.

stories.title: «Silva Lab One”, laboratorio intelligente per gestire il bosco dei Monti Alburni

en.title: Silva Lab One, intelligent laboratory to manage the forest of Monti Alburni
en.summary: Silva Lab One is the first Natural Forest Laboratory established in the southern foothills of Monti Alburni within Cilento National Park, utilizing satellite technologies to manage the forest ecosystem.

stories.title: «Revisione delle regole europee priorità per restare competitivi»

en.title: Review of European rules a priority to remain competitive
en.summary: Italian ceramic industry faces barriers to competitiveness despite European support, with first-half data from Confindustria Ceramica showing increased ceramic tile exports yet regulatory obstacles persist.
